foundersMessage.heading: Where ALL Students are "At Promise"
foundersMessage.paragraphOne: At Segue Institute for Learning, we believe in the boundless potential of every student. Our mission is to cultivate a community where students take ownership of their education, preparing them to excel in high school, college, and beyond. We provide a rigorous academic experience that empowers scholars to view themselves as agents of change in their communities.
foundersMessage.paragraphTwo: Segue IFL scholars receive a rigorous academic experience that prepares them to excel in high school and the future college setting of their choice. At Segue, we believe that all of our students are "AT PROMISE" versus being labeled "At Risk." Segue IFL schools offer safe and nurturing environments which promote diversity, encourage individual growth, and allow students to view themselves as citizens of change in their homes and community.
